title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

reports.title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

summary:
On August 3 in a Cypress neighborhood near Houston, Harris County sheriff's deputies surrounded a Camaro driven by two 19-year-old men, Anthony and Julian, after automated license plate cameras flagged a stolen Camaro linked to several armed robberies. At least five patrol cars and a helicopter responded. Deputies pointed guns, ordered the men to the ground, and handcuffed them before checking their license or registration. One deputy reportedly threatened to shoot and kill Julian, who had cuts and scrapes from being pushed down.

After the men were in handcuffs, deputies realized they had stopped the wrong car. The sheriff's office said supervisors will review body camera footage to see if procedures were followed. The men were given information on filing a formal complaint with internal affairs, and both plan to do so. Anthony's mother, Leslie, is hiring an attorney and wants the deputies held accountable.
title_en: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say
